notes.title: Sektori Demo now available!
notes.notes:
Sektori, the upcoming spiritual sequel to Trigonarium, now has a limited time demo available! Go check it out and wishlist for more twin-stick action!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2105620/Sektori/
